cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
「逆向一切」热度回落
周边项目接着涨
cover.dek: 榜首 morluto/rea 近 14 天日增从 6,492 降到 3,005，但 Awesome-REA、rea-video、bla 今天各涨几百星。热度在往周边扩散，值得看看接棒的是谁。
cover.title_en:
The 'reverse anything' wave cools
but its spin-offs keep climbing
cover.dek_en: morluto/rea's daily gain fell from 6,492 to 3,005 over 14 days, yet Awesome-REA, rea-video and bla each added several hundred stars today. Here is who picked up the slack.

stickers.title: 官方入场
stickers.text: google/skills 日增 +488，此前每天只有二三十，Skills 流量在向官方仓库集中。
stickers.text_en: google/skills gained +488 stars today, up from 20 or 30 a day. Skills traffic is moving to official repos.

stickers.title: 上下文压缩
stickers.text: Coca-Cola 把工具输出压成 latent token，token 降幅在 70.01% 到 89.24% 之间。
stickers.text_en: Coca-Cola compresses tool output into latent tokens and cuts token use by 70.01% to 89.24%.

stickers.title: 任务切换
stickers.text: Switch-SWE 测得交错未完成任务，让 7 个 coding agent 平均少解决 11.5 个百分点。
stickers.text_en: Switch-SWE finds interleaved unfinished tasks cost 7 coding agents 11.5 percentage points on average.
